spans.s: N. of a commentator on the Ṛgveda-prātiśākhya.
ऊलुपिन्, ऊलूक, ऊवट, vv.ll. for उलुपिन्, उलूक, उवट, qq.v.
ऊ—वर्ण m. the letter or sound ऊ, TPrāt.; VPrāt.
or ऊ॑वध्य n. (etym. doubtful) undigested grass &c. in the stomach or bowels (of an animal killed for sacrifice), RV. i, 162, 10; AV.; TS.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr. &c.;
